Record each tool's dimensions, surface and material completeness under E1, re-check under E2, then write the E3 handover. Compare the basis for changes and your willingness to keep training; without real measuring and machining experience, state clearly that it is a paper practice.

The identity is United States O*NET-SOC51-4194.00, and the delivery is a precision grinding, sharpening, polishing or filing result that meets the specification. Equipment repair, forging and rolling each have their own occupational files.

Inputs include drawings, tolerances, the condition of the tool or workpiece, and the process and inspection requirements. Confirm the object, version, material and recording units first, and do not replace the specification with "it looks sharp".

First check that the drawing version, the tool or workpiece identification and the material match the current task. An identity or version conflict is listed as awaiting confirmation; only after confirmation may a trained person prepare the grinding wheel, equipment and process according to the approved procedure.

Monitor the grinding or polishing process, and stop and report when an equipment problem is found; adjustments and restarts follow the on-site authority, and the paper cannot be used to infer that the fault has been resolved.

When the grinding wheel or the grinding setup changes, the suitability, equipment status and inspection items must be confirmed again under the on-site process. Valid instruments are then used to check the dimensions and surface, recording the change and the result; the reader must not change wheels, compensate or start the machine on the basis of a paper description.

Dressing grinding wheels, cleaning and lubricating and replacing worn parts are on the task list, but electrical work, complex repairs and welding must not automatically be incorporated into every role's authorisation.

The quantity, width and angle of cutting tools and the profile each have their own inspection objects; the role direction differs, and the instruments, programmes and evaluation methods need fresh checking.

Delivery must separate machining completion from inspection release. Keep the version, the measurement conditions, the anomalies and the confirming person, and use fictional data or authorised material for public pieces.

The two processes are an editorial summary: CNC tool sharpening centres on the programme, the grinding wheel and dimensional re-checking; hand filing or saw tooth finishing centres on the local profile, the tooth form and item-by-item checking. The following are editorial checking questions arranged from the O*NET tasks. The judgement must go back to the specific drawing, measurement conditions and authority; an occupational description cannot replace training, equipment instructions or quality release rules.

Check the measurement conditions and version first. A single dimensional drift is not enough to prove the cause; keep the original values and hand them to the process staff for analysis.

Machining completion and acceptable release are separate; isolate the defective pieces and record the uninspected items, and let someone with the authority decide the handling.

The work centres on grinders, grinding wheels, hand finishing and instruments, and close observation, repetitive movements, accuracy and standing are worth learning about on site. Noise, contaminant exposure and equipment risks differ between roles, and every workstation must not be assumed to be the same from an occupational label.

Common organisations and locations｜The main O*NET industry is manufacturing; tool grinding may be at tool machining, repair or related metalworking workstations. The Zhengzhou historical recruitment explicitly used a CNC tool grinder, but that company's requirement does not represent all manufacturing units.

Materials and tools of the work｜Drawings, tolerances, grinding wheels, fixtures, instruments and wear records are the key inputs. O*NET lists software such as ANCA ToolRoom, which only shows the occupational technology list; a software name does not constitute an industry-wide mandatory certificate or an AI adoption rate.

Production organisation and pace｜Prepare and confirm the setup first, then monitor the machining and inspection; equipment speed may affect the pace. The inspection frequency and handover requirements for batch production and item-by-item finishing are set by the process.

Scheduling and physical load｜O*NET includes work contexts such as repetitive movements, standing, equipment pace and noise. The actual shifts, hours, rest and exposure controls must be asked about with the specific employer; without the original scheduling text for this role, no uniform two-shift system or overtime hours are set.

Communication and cooperation｜Operation, process, programming and quality control each check the version, setup, measurement and defects. When material conflicts are found, point out the object and the evidence first, and do not write a guess as a confirmed cause.

Re-checking and the chain of responsibility｜After grinding, check the dimensions, surface and wear, distinguishing machining completion, re-measurement completion and formal release. Basic maintenance is not the same as authority for all repairs, and equipment anomalies go to the designated responsible person.

Quality and occupational requirements｜Accurate measuring, finishing to specification, promptly isolating nonconforming pieces and leaving traceable records show work quality better than "grinding fast". The paper practice only shows the judgement process and cannot replace real instruments, equipment training or independent operating ability.

Industrial machinery mechanics diagnose faults and repair production equipment, with restored operating condition and verified repair results as the output; sharpening's object is tool geometry and surface.

How do you choose between the internal tool sharpening directions and the adjacent manufacturing roles?

First compare the CNC tool grinding and the hand／saw tooth finishing inside this occupation, then look at the four frozen adjacent occupations: industrial machinery mechanics, machinery maintenance workers, forging machine setters and operators, and rolling machine setters and operators. They may share a manufacturing site, but the objects, outputs, equipment and responsibilities differ. The choice signals below are editorial suggestions, not an automatic transfer or general recruitment condition.

If you are willing to link the tool drawing, programme and measurement, explore CNC tool grinding first; if you prefer local geometry and item-by-item finishing, learn about saw tooth or filing roles. If you are more interested in equipment restoration or material forming, re-check the training and output against the adjacent role, and do not infer direct competence from years of sharpening.

This occupation uses the 51-4194 tasks; the four adjacent directions use the official files 49-9041, 49-9043, 51-4022 and 51-4023 respectively. The comparison does not merge the occupations' wages or authority, and the paper experience can only narrow the exploration direction.

At the technical ability level: the ANCA GCX white paper states that AEMS uses supervised machine learning to monitor the acoustic emission of grinding wheel dressing and provides on-machine measurement and path compensation. It describes a feature of specific gear skiving cutter equipment and does not mean that any grinder has these abilities, nor that a generative model can set a safe process on its own.

Automation and AI must be separated. The learning algorithm in grinding wheel dressing monitoring, dimensional measurement, path calculation and compensation control are not the same function; a tool grinding software list must not be treated as a machine learning adoption rate either.

At the adoption level: the vendor material shows that a configurable technical solution exists, and this page has no statistics representing the actual installation, continued use or net time saved for this occupation as a whole in China or the United States. Before comparing roles, ask how the specific equipment, version, measurement and manual review are organised.

The remaining responsibility is for an authorised person to confirm the equipment and process, with quality control checking the results under the rules; the tool cannot decide restarts, anomaly rework or release on its own.

At the employment outcome level: BLS projects a 6.8% decline for United States 51-4194 in 2025–2035, with about 500 openings a year; this is a combined occupational projection that cannot be split into AI-caused losses and does not represent an equivalent change in China.

description.text: Tool grinders, filers and sharpeners carry out precision grinding, dressing, polishing and filing on metal tools, cutting edges or related workpieces according to drawings and process requirements, select and dress grinding wheels, measure dimensions and surface condition, isolate nonconforming pieces and record anomalies. CNC sharpening, saw tooth trimming and hand finishing differ in equipment and tasks, and "being able to run a grinder" cannot replace understanding tolerances, instruments and safety boundaries.
